recipe.goal: Define apertures and measure line profiles and moment-0 maps
recipe.method: Extract profiles in 5 arcsec circles, measure zero-intensity line widths of C17O/C18O, build 13CO moment-0 maps over C18O velocity range, choose 5 or 7 arcsec circular apertures (non-circular 3-sigma contour for M1-92; rectangular for Hen 3-1475 high-velocity gas)
key_parameters: Aperture diameters 5 arcsec (GLMP 950, Hen 3-1475) and 7 arcsec (GLMP 953, AFGL 5385, HD 187885)
assumptions: Circular apertures adequate because sources are nearly circular

recipe.goal: Measure continuum flux density, size and position
recipe.method: Integrate continuum within the same apertures; fit 2D Gaussian convolved with beam in the image plane to get beam-deconvolved FWHM

recipe.goal: Derive 17O/18O ratios from C17O/C18O line fluxes
recipe.method: Convert flux ratio to abundance ratio accounting for Einstein A, frequency, partition functions and level energies at Tex = 10 K (ratio ~0.95 times the flux ratio)
assumptions: Same excitation for both molecules; ratio virtually independent of Tex

recipe.goal: Derive circumstellar gas masses from C18O
recipe.method: M_gas = M_H/0.7 with M_H from C18O J=2-1 flux, optically thin LTE at Tex=10 K, f(C18O)=8.5e-7 (2.1e-7 for HD 187885)
key_parameters: f(C18O) = 8.5e-7 relative to H nuclei; hydrogen mass fraction 0.7
assumptions: Tex = 10 K; adopted distances; C18O abundance from Karakas & Lugaro 2016 models

recipe.goal: Derive kinematic ages and recent mass-loss rates
recipe.method: Use 3-sigma C18O contours for size and gas mass; kinematic age from region size, adopted distance and expansion velocity from zero-intensity C18O width; mass-loss rate = mass within the contour / kinematic age

recipe.goal: Derive 13CO abundances consistent with C18O masses
recipe.method: Analogous expression to the mass equation to find the 13CO abundance relative to H that reproduces the C18O-based gas mass

recipe.goal: Infer initial masses from 17O/18O with stellar evolution models
recipe.method: Compare measured ratios with MONASH and FRUITY model predictions at solar (and Z=0.0035/0.0028 for HD 187885) metallicity

recipe.goal: Check luminosities and distances implied by initial masses
recipe.method: Take maximum post-AGB luminosity from Miller Bertolami (2016) models for the inferred initial mass and rescale distances from adopted luminosities

recipe.goal: Compare kinematic ages with post-AGB evolution timescales
recipe.method: Compare C18O kinematic ages with tau_tr from Miller Bertolami (2016) and Vassiliadis & Wood (1994) for the four sources with spectral types
assumptions: Kinematic ages are upper limits to post-AGB duration
